body:
Kanban card 123214231: 'we need a big_o account creation interface off of iduna'. BIG_O has no native client yet (NORTHSTAR only), so unlike DEADWEIGHT (whose signup UI lives inside dw_gui), this is a plain public web page hosted directly on IDUNA at /play/big_o, driving the exact same generic per-game guest-register/guest-login/guest-upgrade API (internal/http/handlers/game_online.go) every internal/games.Registry entry already gets for free. Added a new 'big_o' row to games.Registry (PlayPerm only -- no bot/match/checkpoints permissions yet since no BIG_O server exists to hold them) + one migration registering big_o.play. No new tables needed -- players/game_guest_credentials/game_signup_log/player_credentials are already shared, game-agnostic tables. 3 new tests, all passing. Live-verified end to end against production: page loads, real guest account created, logged back in with the returned credentials, email linked (account_state flipped guest->base), test data cleaned up afterward.

⚓ ☃
title: BIG_O account-creation interface (/play/big_o), off IDUNA's own generic guest-account API
